data.one_liner: Parse ID3 tags from audio files in pure Dart
data.what_it_does: dart_tags provides a pure Dart library to read ID3 tags from audio files. It supports multiple ID3 versions and can be used in Flutter, web, and VM projects.
use_when: Need to read metadata from MP3 files in a Flutter or Dart application
Working in a web or server environment where native Dart code is preferred
avoid_when: Need to write or modify ID3 tags
Require advanced tag manipulation beyond reading
strengths: Pure Dart implementation, no native dependencies
weaknesses: Only reads tags, does not support writing
Limited tag set support compared to full editors
